responsibility: Implements GCC’s RTL basic-block layout optimization passes that reorder machine-level CFG blocks to improve fallthrough and code locality, partition hot and cold regions into separate sections, and duplicate computed-goto blocks when profitable. It owns the trace-construction and trace-connection heuristics, hot/cold crossing-edge repair, and target-sensitive branch-fixup logic needed after layout changes, and it exposes the `reorder blocks` and `partition blocks` pass bodies that consume CFG/profile probabilities and produce a reordered cfglayout RTL function with updated jumps, labels, and partition metadata.
same_name_distinction: Implements the RTL block-reordering and hot/cold partitioning passes themselves, including trace formation, layout rewrites, and crossing-edge branch fixups; unlike gcc/bb-reorder.h, which only exposes the small target-specific interface and helpers those passes use.
